title: savefig into an io.BytesIO and then close(): native has a figure, Tavotto captures zero
affected_script_shapes: a script that renders into an in-memory io.BytesIO buffer with savefig(buf, format=...) and then closes the figure (typically to embed or post-process the bytes)
root_cause: The Safe worker captures a figure only through savefig to a file path (and show); a savefig to a file-like object writes no artifact on disk and the figure is closed right after, so nothing is registered and the probe ends with script_no_figure although `python script.py` rendered a figure (issue #749, split out of #739). Known product gap, not fixed: no fix_pr.

verified.route: Safe engine path via the product discovery chain

unverified: a real user session through the UI

recurrence: 1 of the 5 output_call candidates in a local explore (seed 7, parent shape_oo_savefig); also every bytesio_close candidate in the CG-08 RealExecution test (shape_oo_savefig, shape_entry_main)
